svg.title: Concorde Relief
svg.desc: Schematic visual study after the cited photograph. Approximate geometry and standardized colors; wall and cast shadows omitted. White rear rectangle is retained; black six-sided foreground overlap follows the oblique photograph. Exact offset amount and projection are approximate.
